added_comments.text: Lines are rounded individually, so their sum can drift from the order-level total by several minor units (more with many lines). Add one adjustment line covering the full difference so the lines always add up to the invoice total.

rationale: The agent replaced the hardcoded ±$0.01 adjustment with the actual computed diff, which reconciles any size of rounding drift rather than only ever covering one cent, and switched the total calculation to the currency-aware roundMoney helper instead of a hardcoded *100 rounding — both fix the underlying defect class rather than special-casing the reported $0.02 example. The currency-aware rounding is used consistently everywhere and roundMoney itself (which presumably implements the JPY whole-yen half-up rule) is untouched, so the protected JPY behavior is preserved.
